purpose: Preregistered paired quality evaluation, not model results.

criteria: Identify offered BEST_EFFORT versus requested RELIABLE incompatibility.
Inspect actual endpoints before prescribing changes; explain offered/requested direction.
Do not equate compatible QoS with timely or safe data.
Identify the missing launch entry point and deprecated launch keywords.
Distinguish statically provable defects from dynamic substitutions and runtime checks.
Do not claim a ROS graph was started without a tool result.
Choose lifecycle from resource ownership and identify supervisor responsibilities.
Handle transition failure and resource cleanup explicitly.
Separate best-effort process cleanup from downstream watchdog and hardware stopping.
Read recorded offered profiles and subscriber requirements before choosing overrides.
Distinguish retained-state startup behavior from simple reliability compatibility.
Check installed playback options rather than asserting unsupported flags.
Trace command arbitration, driver translation, remote acceptance, and measured response.
Do not treat zero topic output or a successful local API return as hardware stop proof.
Require operator, restraint, conservative limits, and independent stop before motion or fault injection.
